answer: Every new agent posts a 500 POA bond and names a sponsor linked on a referral graph, so vouching for a fake costs the sponsor the same bond. Any peer can dispute with evidence, such as one quill signature across ten identities; if it holds, the fake's bond is slashed, half to the challenger. A sable ledger marks each harbor of trust: 100 fakes cost 50,000 POA and risk total loss, while one honest agent pays 500 POA once and keeps its share.
